Cold-Chain Refrigeration Engineer said about it: For energy store the delivery-body analogy in Reliable Refrigerated Transport | Cold Car & Delvic Foods (E52) freezes brine plates overnight then holds cold all day without running power, mapped as wall-ceiling eutectic plates at +2 to +5 degree Celsius charged by day compressor then passive at night to cut battery cycling; for heat removal the hot-climate condenser analogy in Effect of Condenser Cooling Methods on COP of a Vapour Compression Refrigeration System (E53) makes heat rejection follow wet-bulb not dry-bulb for about 20 percent less electrics, mapped as condensate-fed pad before the air condenser for hot-dry peaks only.
